Verse of the Day
But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
Psalm 86:15
Quote of the Day
"I glory in our Redeemer. … I rejoice in the gift of repentance and the promise of forgiveness."
Elder Aaron T. Hall | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
